newsitem.title: GERMANY: Jil Sander sees stagnant profit in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Jil Sander sees stagnant profit in 1997.

text.p: German women's fashion group Jil Sander AG said at its annual general meeting on Friday it expected sales in 1997 to rise almost 10 percent but operating profits to stagnate.
The company's sales rose in 1996 to 172.7 million marks from 163.2 million in 1995 but net profit fell to 11.1 million marks in 1996 from 12.4 million a year earlier.
The fashion group said it would pay an unchanged dividend of 27.50 marks per preference share and 25 marks per ordinary share on the 1996 results.
